pillar_reactions.evidence: All three pillars were delivered on the first call of this deal. Nothing about training or mobility was presented here.

Reinforced rather than presented. The rep's closing advice was 'over communicate with Trevor is when something is feeling off or it hurts or whatever... if you know that you won't be able to hit the four workouts communicate that and maybe just do two, it's still better than nothing.' Prospect agreed without questions: 'Yeah, yeah, yeah. Okay.'

unmet_demand.want: A straight answer on whether a 30-day or money-back guarantee exists if his body does not respond to the programme
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The question was answered with a strength-performance guarantee instead. No refund or cancellation term was stated in either direction, before or after a $6,000 full-price payment.

unmet_demand.want: Confirmation that the kettlebell movement library is compatible with a ganglion cyst that is painful under loaded wrist extension
unmet_demand.why_unmet: There is no clinical screening step in the process and nobody in the sale is qualified to answer it. The question was routed to the coach after the money had already been taken.
